scope: Independent CPU-only control-order and original-material-corner audit of all four grasps, plus actual native-pose pad geometry at production completion and after the extra hold. Does not certify mass, material response, force closure, or continuous triangle collision.
binding_rule: At least two qualifying original-corner pad-support particles on each finger, connectivity and selected-point gates; one representative per finger may be hand-bound.
fresh_pre_lift_rule: Production both_fingers_contact means at least one cloth particle near each pad. It is distinct from the binding-time >=2 support test.
extra_end_support_rule: Repeat >=2 original-corner nodes per finger at the original pad-distance threshold as an additional end-state proximity diagnostic. This is not a re-run of every binding-time topology/strain constraint or an original production end condition.
sampled_support_note: Additional controller-event samples exist; no continuous/substep support assertion is inferred between samples.
limitations: Native arrival is a geometric full-finger SDF measurement, not measured contact force.
Pad support is particle-sphere proximity to authored pad boxes, not a force-closure or cloth-to-arm load-transfer validation.
Bound particle identities may change between grasps within the same original 22 mm material corner; they remain unchanged during each lift.
The final 4 s observation is an additional hold after production completion, not a new production acceptance threshold.
